key.name: tone
key.description: Use a tone for the break time alarm

key.name: break-percentage
key.summary: Percentage of work time to take into break time

key.name: months-saved
key.description: The amount of months the statistical information will be retained. In case its overpassed, that data will be deleted

key.name: autostart
key.description: Automatically start timer when the stage is changed

key.name: distraction-free
key.description: The distraction free mode uses a special window without too much clutter. Ideal when you just want what matters

key.name: activate-screensaver
key.description: Activates the screensaver when the break stage starts

key.name: keep-running-in-background
key.summary: Keep running in background when window is closed
key.description: Hide window to GNOME Background Apps instead of stopping when closing the window while a timer is active

key.name: carry-balance
key.description: Persist the work/break debt-and-credit ledger across application restarts

key.name: balance-ms
key.description: Nonnegative values store unspent earned work milliseconds; negative values store negative overrun break milliseconds

key.name: auto-reset-debt-policy
key.description: Schedule for automatically clearing unpaid work debt while keeping earned break credit

key.name: weekly-reset-day
key.description: Day of the week for weekly work-debt auto-resets

key.name: reset-hour
key.description: Local hour (0-23) at which daily or weekly work-debt resets occur

key.name: last-debt-reset-utc
key.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the most recently applied work-debt reset boundary

key.name: alert-break-exhausted
key.summary: Alert when break credit is exhausted
key.description: Play tone and send notification when break credit reaches zero

key.name: alert-debt-cleared
key.summary: Alert when work debt is paid off
key.description: Play tone and send notification when work debt reaches zero
